title: GG booking failed on Claim Overview: message and retry
walkthroughSteps: Claim event and section events each get their own message on Claim Overview, with the failure text from Global Genius.
Retry is on the message itself, for the claim and for each section. The row changes at once, a toast and the bell say how it went.
When the booking goes through, the message is gone. Figma file and the role question (who may retry) are not covered here: everyone with the claim open can retry, as for payments.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC01 · Claim booking failed: message with the Global Genius failure text
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Red banner **Global Genius processing failed**: "Claim couldn't be processed in Global Genius: BKG-4102 ... not mapped to a Global Genius ledger. Retry to process it again." Then a **Retry** link.

**Decision:** Global Genius's own message is shown in the banner text, as the colleague's Figma design has it (GG-DASH-2 in gg-dashboard.model.ts). After a retry that failed, it is shown under the text again, labelled "Message from Global Genius" (DESIGN DECISION GG-MSG-1).

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira says nothing about the banner wording. The first-failure wording comes from the colleague's Figma design; the retried and Finance wording ("on hold") is decided by the prototype. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC01 · Section booking failed: message per section with the Global Genius failure text
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Red banner "2 sections couldn't be booked in Global Genius". One row per section: the section name, its **Message from Global Genius**, a short line on what to do, and a **Retry** link.

**Decision:** sections only go to Global Genius once the claim is there, so the section message is hidden while the claim banner shows. Fix the claim first, the sections follow.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC02 · Retry the claim event: feedback, then it fails again
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Same red claim banner as AC-01.

**Try:** Press **Retry**: the banner turns blue ("Retrying") at once, then comes back red after about 3 seconds saying the retry failed, with one more retry left. The Global Genius message is shown again.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira does not say who may retry. The prototype lets anyone who opens the claim press Retry. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC02 · Retry a section event: feedback, then it fails again
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Red banner with one section, Contents & Fixtures Damage, and its Global Genius message.

**Try:** Press **Retry**: the row shows a spinner and "Retrying" at once. After about 3 seconds a red toast says it still couldn't be booked, the row comes back with "Retried, still not booked. You can retry once more" and the bell lists it.

**Decision:** Retry has no confirm dialog, same as the claim retry from GG-2: it sends the same event again and moves no money. Feedback instead: the row turns to Retrying straight away, then a toast and a bell line say how it went. Two failed retries hand it to Finance and the Retry link goes (DESIGN DECISION GG-SEC-1).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC03 · Retry works: the failure message is removed
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Red banner with one section, Property Damage, and its Global Genius message.

**Try:** Press **Retry**: "Retrying", then after about 3 seconds the banner is gone, a green toast says the section is now booked, and the bell shows it under Done.

The claim event works the same way: apply GG 1 · AC-01 and retry, the red banner turns green.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Repeated failures: retried twice, now with Finance
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Red banner "1 section still couldn't be booked in Global Genius: now with Finance". The row keeps the Global Genius message and says Finance is fixing it. **No** Retry link. The bell lists it under "Someone else is on it".

**Decision (epic open point: repeated failures):** after two failed retries the handler can't usefully retry again, so the Retry link goes and Finance owns it. Same rule as the claim event (GG-2).

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** The epic leaves repeated failures as an open point. The prototype decides two retries, then the item goes to Finance with no Retry link. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Claim not in Global Genius yet: section failures wait for the claim
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Only the red claim banner. The two failed sections are **not** listed yet.

**Try:** Retry the claim (it works in this setup): the claim banner turns green, and the section banner with both sections appears under it.

**Decision:** sections only go to Global Genius once the claim is there, so the section message is hidden while the claim banner shows. Fix the claim first, the sections follow.
